mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, real_name, age, height_cm, weight_kg, phone, practitioner_id FROM t_patient_profile WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_patient_profile (user_id, real_name, age, height_cm, weight_kg, phone, practitioner_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{age}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{phone}, #{practitionerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_patient_profile SET user_id=#{userId}, real_name=#{realName}, age=#{age}, height_cm=#{heightCm}, weight_kg=#{weightKg}, phone=#{phone}, practitioner_id=#{practitionerId} WHERE id=#{id}
